result.title: VL-Dedup: Graded Multimodal Entity Resolution for Image-Text Data Deduplication
result.summary: Image-text corpora contain copies of one image, captions that describe one image in different ways, captions reused for different images, and captions that do not match their images. Each case calls for a different curation action. Deduplication and multimodal entity resolution (ER) only decide whether records are the same, and they are evaluated on labeled pairs. Yet pair scores do not tell which records end up in the same cluster or which useful captions get deleted. We therefore formulate image-text deduplication as graded multimodal ER, which decides visual identity, caption handling, and mismatches for each pair, and we evaluate it at three levels: pairs, clusters, and the retained set. Our method, VL-Dedup, groups records of the same visual entity into clusters and caps the size of each cluster. Within each cluster, a vision-language model (VLM) and CLIPScore decide which captions to keep and which to flag. We also build VL-DedupBench, with 50,000 COCO and SOP records and 66,788 labeled pairs. On it, a classifier that selects no false edge among the labeled pairs still joins millions of record pairs from different entities. Spending VLM calls on the pairs inside clusters, rather than on pairs with uncertain scores, gives better caption decisions from the same model. Even when almost all clusters are correct, keeping one record per cluster loses facts in many deletions, while the deletions of VL-Dedup lose much less information.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把图文去重形式化为分级多模态实体解析：对每对记录判定视觉同一性、caption 处理方式与图文不匹配；方法 VL-Dedup 按视觉实体聚类并限制簇大小，簇内用 VLM 与 CLIPScore 决定保留或标记哪些 caption，并在 pair、cluster、保留集三层评估，同时构建 VL-DedupBench。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「分级判定+以保留集信息损失而非配对分数衡量」的做法，可能可供核查用于 LVR 中冗余视觉证据或缓存状态的保留与合并决策，以及如何评价内容是否真正被保留；但任务是数据策展，未涉及推理期状态生成。
